component.name: Savage Wind
component.summary: Static recompilation of Breath of the Wild (bring your own game files)

description.p: Savage Wind Recomp is a work-in-progress static recompilation of The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild (Nintendo Switch, version 1.9.0) into a native Linux application. It aims to be a full PC version of your own copy of the game: PC-style graphics options, any controller, keyboard and mouse support, and the game's text and voices in any language.
This is an unofficial Flatpak wrapper around the official upstream AppImage release. It packages the already-compiled binary as-is.

IMPORTANT: This package contains no game files, keys, firmware or dumping tools. You must supply your own legally obtained copy of the game, updated to version 1.9.0, dumped from your own console. On first launch the application asks for the folder holding the extracted ExeFS and RomFS, then recompiles the game code locally on your machine with the bundled toolchain.
Requirements: an x86-64 CPU with SSE4.2, a GPU with a Vulkan 1.3 driver, 16 GB of RAM and about 20 GB of free disk space.

developer.name: Revivedx and the Savage Wind Recomp contributors

description.p: Packages the upstream Savage Wind Alpha 5 (0.5.0-alpha.5) AppImage release.
